name: EURe
who_can_redeem: Holders have an at-par redemption right; Monerium wallet-IBAN flows mint EURe from incoming SEPA euros and burn EURe for outgoing SEPA payments subject to account and compliance terms.
redemption_region_notes: Availability depends on Monerium onboarding, supported jurisdictions, account eligibility, payment rails, network support, and applicable compliance requirements.
redemption_notes: Monerium states that EURe is fully backed by safeguarded euro reserves and redeemable at par; current product documentation also describes automatic bank-to-wallet minting and wallet-to-bank burning flows.
summary: Regulated euro e-money token issued by Monerium with safeguarded euro reserves, at-par redemption rights, SEPA-connected wallet IBAN flows, and official deployments across multiple public chains.
notes: Growth E Batch U. Exact original launch day remains unresolved; contract identities are recorded only where the current official EURe page publishes exact mainnet addresses.
